NAME

PPI::Token::QuoteLike::Backtick - A `backticks` command token

INHERITANCE

  PPI::Token::QuoteLike::Backtick
  isa PPI::Token::QuoteLike
      isa PPI::Token
          isa PPI::Element

DESCRIPTION

A "PPI::Token::QuoteLike::Backtick" object represents a command output capturing quote.

METHODS

There are no methods available for "PPI::Token::QuoteLike::Backtick" beyond those provided by the parent PPI::Token::QuoteLike, PPI::Token and PPI::Element classes.
